description: This source file implements functions related to diffing and file manipulation, including square root approximation, diff record emission, file size/first record retrieval, memory management for a custom data structure, line sampling, whitespace analysis, line comparison, hashing utilities, and diff hunk formatting.

methods.name: long xdl_bogosqrt(long n)
methods.description: Approximate the integer square root of a number using shifts.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diffrec(char const * rec,long size,char const * pre,long psize,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emit a diff record, possibly appending a no-newline marker if needed.

methods.name: void * xdl_mmfile_first(mmfile_t * mmf,long * size)
methods.description: Retrieve the first pointer and size of an mmfile.

methods.name: long xdl_mmfile_size(mmfile_t * mmf)
methods.description: Return the size of an mmfile.

methods.name: int xdl_cha_init(chastore_t * cha,long isize,long icount)
methods.description: Initialize a chastore_t structure for memory management.

methods.name: void xdl_cha_free(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Free all nodes within a chastore_t structure.

methods.name: void * xdl_cha_alloc(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Allocate a chunk within a chastore_t structure.

methods.name: long xdl_guess_lines(mmfile_t * mf,long sample)
methods.description: Estimate the number of lines in a mmfile based on sampling.

methods.name: int xdl_blankline(const char * line,long size,long flags)
methods.description: Check if a line consists only of whitespace, considering flags.

methods.name: int xdl_recmatch(const char * l1,long s1,const char * l2,long s2,long flags)
methods.description: Compare two lines with optional whitespace and formatting flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)
methods.description: Compute a hash of a record accounting for whitespace depending on flags.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_verbatim(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top)
methods.description: Compute a hash of a record exactly as bytes without skipping characters.

methods.name: unsigned int xdl_hashbits(unsigned int size)
methods.description: Calculate the number of bits needed for a given hash table size.

methods.name: int xdl_num_out(char * out,long val)
methods.description: Convert a long integer to decimal string and return the length.

methods.name: int xdl_format_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Format a diff hunk header line.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emit a diff hunk header using callback functions.

methods.name: int xdl_fall_back_diff(xdfenv_t * diff_env,xpparam_t const * xpp,int line1,int count1,int line2,int count2)
methods.description: Perform a fallback diff on file segments using alternative methods.

methods.name: void * xdl_alloc_grow_helper(void * p,long nr,long * alloc,size_t size)
methods.description: Helper function to grow a dynamically allocated array.
